gallery.intro: Pick an example and LOKI does it right away, in a new chat. Nothing on your computer is changed. Change the words afterwards to make it yours.
gallery.none: No example matches. Try another word, or just ask LOKI in your own words.

help.english_only: This article is only in English for now.
help.none: Nothing found. Try a shorter word, or ask LOKI: it can explain itself.

ob.approve: Approve LOKI in the browser tab that opened. Waiting…
ob.bg_done: LOKI now runs on this computer - private, free, offline.
ob.bg_failed: The local model did not install: {error}

ob.connected: Connected: LOKI is using {name}. You can go on, or pick another below.

ob.expired: This sign-in expired. Press the button to try again.
ob.found_none: No local model app yet - LOKI installs Ollama for you (free, open source).

ob.found_ollama_off: Ollama is installed (LOKI will start it)
ob.hello: Hi, I'm LOKI - your helper on this computer
ob.help_title: What would you like help with?
ob.help_why: Pick as many as you like. LOKI shows you matching examples first; it can still help with anything.
ob.install_ollama_help: How to install Ollama by hand
ob.key_empty: Paste the key first (copy it from the {name} page).
ob.key_hint: {name} keys start with {hint} - check you copied all of it.
ob.key_retry: Copy it again (all of it) and paste it, or make a new key.
ob.local_busy: Downloading… (see the progress at the bottom right)
ob.local_done: Done - LOKI now runs on this computer.
ob.local_failed: That did not start: {error}. Try again, install Ollama yourself from ollama.com/download, or use a free online model.
ob.local_install: Set it up for me ({model}, {size} GB download)
ob.local_meanwhile: Tip: choose Both to chat online while it downloads.
ob.local_no_fit: No local model fits this computer well ({why}). A free online model is the better choice here.
ob.local_reco: Recommended for this computer: {model} ({size} GB). It downloads in the background - you can keep going.
ob.local_starting: Starting… you can keep reading; this runs in the background.
ob.local_unknown: Could not check this computer. Try again, or use a free online model.
ob.local_upgrade: A bigger, smarter model ({model}) also fits: Settings > Local models, later.
ob.local_why: Private and free, works without internet. Needs a few GB of disk and a one-time download.
ob.machine_drafted: This translation was drafted by a machine and is waiting for review by a native speaker.
ob.make_key: Create an API key there and copy it.
ob.mlx_note: MLX is installed: {repo} also runs on this Mac (Settings > Local models).
ob.model_why: LOKI needs an AI model to think with. Both choices below are free. You can change it any time in Settings.
ob.model_why2: Pick one - or both. Nothing here makes you wait: downloads run in the background and you can change it any time in Settings.
ob.no_model_warn: LOKI cannot answer until a model is connected. You can do it later in Settings > Connections, or from the ? help.
ob.none_yet: No model is connected yet. Pick one:
ob.nvidia_why: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, free - LOKI's main driver: fast, smart, calls tools.
ob.or_how: Sign in (or make a free account) in your browser and approve LOKI - no key to copy.
ob.paste_key: Paste it here - it stays on this computer.
ob.point1: Ask me anything, in your own words: write a letter, plan a week, explain a bill, learn something new.
ob.point2: I can also work on files on this computer - but I always ask before doing anything risky.
ob.point3: I can run completely on this computer, private and free, or use a free online model.
ob.signin_failed: Could not start the sign-in: {error}. Check the internet connection and try again, or use another option.
ob.title: Welcome to LOKI
ob.try_no_model: No model is connected yet, so LOKI cannot answer. Go Back one step to connect a free one.
ob.try_why: Each one runs in a new chat and changes nothing on your computer.
ob.way_both_sub: Chat online right away while the local model downloads.
ob.way_cloud_sub: Fast on any computer. Free options: OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Groq, Gemini.
ob.way_local_nofit: No local model fits this computer well
ob.way_local_sub: Free and private. Works offline once it is downloaded.
